title: Nergigante Origin
description: A mod that adds the Nergigante Origin!
body:
An origin mod based on the Nergigante from Monster Hunter!
I tried to make it as accurate as I could, while making it somewhat balanced.
(Based a bit more on MHS2)

This origin gives you 15 powers, 8 are strengths, 7 are weaknesses, and 3 are activatable powers!


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  
- Nergigante
    
  - Known as the extinction Dragon, the Nergigante is an elder dragon from the game Monster                  Hunter!
  - **Powers**
 
     - **Charge**
  
         -  You have horns for a reason, charge into your enemies for damage!

     - **Explosive Punch**
  
         -  You don't have a projectile like most dragons, you face your enemies head on with your fists!

     - **Roar**
  
         -  A roar so powerful it can scare any mob!

     - **Carnivore**

         -   You can only eat meat!

     - **Slow Swimmer**

         - Your bulky form makes you struggle in water!

     - **Increased Appetite**

         - Your large size requires more food to maintain!

     - **Lightning Weakness**

         - Your weak to lightning!

     - **Pickaxes**

         - A good pickaxe can break your spikes, be careful around them!

     - **Height**

         - Your a big dragon, your taller then most!

     - **Unwieldy**

         - You cannot use shields!

     - **Flight**

         - Most Dragons can fly, including you. You start with an elytra!

     - **Resistance**

         - You have some of the toughest scales of any dragon, giving you natural resistance!

     - **Spikes**

         - Your a spikey dragon, you have natural thorns!

     - **Strength**

         - One of the strongest Elder dragons, you have natural strength and health!

     - **Strong Hands**

         - Your strong enough to break stone with your fists!


</details>

Check out the mod to try the powers!
I hope you enjoy!
